name: Primrose Knight
source:
Cordell has one mission, to survive the night long enough to see the sun rise. He pairs up with Bartholomew, an irritated knight who rather be anywhere else than here.

[from [url=https://cervineprince.itch.io/primrose-knight]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
科德尔的使命只有一个，那就是熬过夜晚并看到日出。他与巴塞洛缪搭档，巴塞洛缪是一位愤怒的骑士，宁愿去其他地方也不愿在这里。

[来自[url=https://cervineprince.itch.io/primrose-knight]itch.io[/url]]
